lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Distinct vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. In the mid-flank region, a cluster of five spots forms an irregular rectangular arrangement between the two most prominent horizontal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal carinae to form a grid. High-luminance circular blobs are positioned at several of these intersection points, particularly in the mid-flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring a high-intensity dorsal edge and a lower-intensity ventral shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single remora is attached to the lateral flank posterior to the fifth gill slit, causing a localized occlusion of the underlying spot pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin exhibits a high concentration of small, high-luminance spots, with the highest density appearing toward the distal edge.
